originalEntry.title: Topic showreel template with brand colors
originalEntry.title_zh: 可换主题和品牌色的作品集模板
originalEntry.author: polydao
originalEntry.description: A fill-in version of the résumé showreel prompt with slots for length, topic and brand colors, sound synced to cuts; run in Claude Code on max.
originalEntry.description_zh: 简历作品集提示词的填空版，可填时长、主题和品牌色，声音卡剪辑点；在 Claude Code 里用 max 档跑。
originalEntry.prompt:
Make a dynamic [24]-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a resume. Go all out.

Only about [TOPIC]. Style: [BRAND COLORS], sound synced to the cuts.
originalEntry.prompt_zh:
制作一段 [24] 秒的动态图形视频，展示你是多么出色的动效设计师，就像简历里的作品集一样。拿出全部本事。

只围绕 [TOPIC]。风格：[BRAND COLORS]，声音与剪辑点同步。
